reason: Conversation 1 explained RCD vs MCB, asked exactly the right discriminating questions (which device trips, timing on heated vs cold cycles, other socket), correctly concluded the fault is in the machine not the house wiring, told him to stop resetting on heated washes and never bypass RCD protection, and offered an insulation-resistance test via an engineer alongside a model-specific part.
